items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $170 from $185 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $170 from $185 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. The firm is citing lower near-term earnings estimates following the recent pullback in spot lithium prices. Lithium demand strength does not appear to be abating; the firm

items.headline: Albemarle Corp: Q3 2026 Earnings Call on Nov 5, 2026 - Transcript
items.snippet: Global lithium consumption increased 48% year-to-date, led by energy storage and rebounding EV demand. Lithium demand continues to outpace supply growth. Specialties adjusted EBITDA outlook raised; full-year capex reduced.
